_comment: Handles for the FOLLOW tab. Each cron, Grok fetches each handle's TOP-VIEWED post in the past 24h and the Follow tab ranks them by view count. Edit this list to add or remove people. Visitor suggestions land in stories.json under 'follow_suggest' (24h public window) — review them and append the keepers here. Handles are case-insensitive on X, but keep the casing the account uses on X profile for display.
